name: vibeview
stderr:
Usage: vibeview [options] [command]

VibeView CLI -- run your app on cloud iOS simulators, Android emulators, Apple
TV, Android TV and Roku devices: a React Native dev loop (dev), device control
for you or your coding agent (ui-tree, tap, mcp), and tests from CI (run-test,
run-suites)

Options:
  -V, --version                    output the version number
  -h, --help                       display help for command

Commands:
  run-suite [options] <suite-id>   Run all test cases in a suite
  run-suites [options]             Run all suites matching a tag filter
  run-test [options] <test-id>     Run a single test case
  list-suites [options]            List available test suites
  list-apps [options]              List apps in your organization
  list-builds [options] <app>      List an app's uploaded builds, newest first:
                                   id, version, platform, debug/release, upload
                                   time and note (the ids `dev --build <id>` and
                                   `run-test --build` take)
  list-devices [options]           List devices registered with the platform
                                   (filterable by type and category)
  upload-app [options] <file>      Upload an app build (zipped simulator .app
                                   for iOS/tvOS, .apk for Android/Android TV, or
                                   a Roku channel .zip)
  create-test [options] [name]     Create a standalone AI test case
  login [options]                  Log in to VibeView (interactive)
  logout                           Revoke the saved login token and remove it
                                   from ~/.vibeview/config.json
  dev [options]                    Stream your app from the fleet with live
                                   Metro hot-reload (RN debug builds), or press
                                   `r` to re-package and reload a Roku channel
                                   in place
  build [options]                  Run your configured build command and upload
                                   the result (see vibeview.json)
  submit [options]                 Submit a succeeded production cloud build's
                                   artifact to TestFlight (ios/tvos) or a Google
                                   Play track (android/androidtv) — binary
                                   upload only; store listing and review stay in
                                   the store consoles
  builds                           Manage cloud builds (see `vibeview build
                                   --cloud`)
  versions                         Manage an app's server-side build-number
                                   counters (used by vibeview.json
                                   `build.autoIncrement` production builds)
  whoami [options]                 Show which account and role this CLI is
                                   authenticated as
  env                              Manage cloud build environment variables and
                                   secrets
  credentials                      Manage app-signing credentials for production
                                   cloud builds
  webhooks                         Manage build-completion webhook endpoints
  dev-status [options]             Show the status of a `vibeview dev --detach`
                                   session in this project
  dev-stop [options]               Stop a `vibeview dev --detach` session in
                                   this project
  stop [options] <session-id>      Stop any session by id — e.g. one started
                                   from the API, the sandbox, or a collaboration
                                   link (`dev-stop` stops this project's
                                   detached dev session without an id)
